fieldValues.title: B5. Build
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Aim: one claimed issue, built in an isolated worktree, gates judged by exit code.

Tried: /ship with checkpoints A, B, C; scripts/wt; the wg-builder and unattended-worker routines; srs-rust ship stages 0 to 9 with dogfooding.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Trade-off: autonomy ↔ supervision. Much autonomous machinery was built, but the work that moves is mostly owner-present local sessions.
- Gone wrong: WG Third-party ready merged 0 of 10 in most cycles (run reports 0867a03f, 2dd29261); every routine stopped behind a broken canary from 10-23; 140 worktrees, about 115 removable; stuck claims (clerk#25, srs-rust#1264); stale binaries and siblings (srs#874); orchestrator traps (finding 1d681412).
